name: Steam Sniper
author: nille
description: Notify when games are free on the Steam store.

barWidget.description: Watch Steam for games that are currently free and notify when new ones appear.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to check Steam for free games.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is free
schema.description: Remove the bar icon when Steam has no free games, instead of showing a dimmed one.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when a newly free game appears.

schema.label: Steam country code
schema.description: Optional two-letter Steam store country (US, DE, GB). Leave empty to let Steam choose from your network.
